reviewNotes: Four actual Codex planning jobs generated three distinct stories; authentication was explicitly revised once after correcting audit input expectations. Each final plan was reviewed and approved as runtime data.

The original authentication run and AI-free replay each retain PASS 4 / FAIL 2. The benchmark rejects malformed email before credential validation and returns 401 for anonymous access. Original approved requirements and failed evidence were not mutated.

Valid-looking literal email input remains rejected. Human review replaced a sanitized dummy literal with an owned unique address reservation; this reserves an address without creating an account. The Invalid credentials assertion was retained.
Human review removed redundant link clicks after approved destination replay from the navigation proposal; every destination and visibility assertion was retained.

Intermediate saved/approved revisions remain historical. Full replay here means every scenario in the three explicitly selected final revisions, not every intermediate revision with incomplete permissions.

PID-start identity is strongest on Linux; unverifiable process ownership stays live/fail-closed.
